name: 咕咕办公
description: Its skill office reads and changes a chat folder's .pptx and .xlsx: the same file, its next version. In the App a person picks what should change and puts it in the composer as pills, slide and shape or a sheet's cells; a pill clicked opens the file there.
subtitle: Slides and sheets with agents

zh.name: 咕咕办公
zh.description: 打开群文件夹里的演示稿和表格，点选或框选要改的地方，一起交给 agent 去改；改好的是同一个文件的下一版。它自己的一页在群里打开时列出、搜索本群的文件，在左栏打开时列出最近打开的文件，都能搜索所有群的文件。
zh.subtitle: 与 agent 协作修改演示稿和表格

en.name: Gugu Office
en.description: Open the decks and spreadsheets in a chat's folder, pick or box what should change, and hand it to an agent; what it changes is the same file's next version. Its own page lists a chat's files when opened in it, else those opened lately, and searches every chat's.
en.subtitle: Slides and sheets with agents

author: 咕咕
